title: Special provision for deduction of tax at source for non-filers of income-tax return (Omitted effective 1 April 2025)

effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: CRITICAL SUNSET: Section 206AB (and Section 206CCA) is formally omitted by the Finance Act, 2025 with effect from 1 April 2025. Post-sunset, tax deductors are relieved from performing portal compliance checks for specified persons, and standard statutory TDS rates apply without non-filer punitive multipliers. Higher rates under Section 206AA (for failure to furnish PAN or inoperative PAN due to non-linkage with Aadhaar) continue independently at 20% (or 5% cap for goods u/s 194Q).

plainTextSummary: Where tax was required to be deducted at source prior to 1 April 2025 on any sum paid or payable to a specified person (a person who had not filed their ITR for the preceding financial year and had aggregate TDS/TCS of ₹50,000 or more in said year), tax was deducted at the higher of: (i) twice the rate specified in the relevant Act, (ii) twice the rate in force, or (iii) 5%. Effective 1 April 2025, Section 206AB was formally omitted by the Finance Act, 2025. For deductions on or after 1 April 2025, Section 206AB is obsolete and standard TDS rates apply. Higher rates under Section 206AA for invalid/missing PAN remain fully active.

keyStatutoryThresholds.penaltyMultiplier: Twice the applicable rate or 5%, whichever is higher
keyStatutoryThresholds.section206aaHarmonization: Higher of Section 206AA rate (20%) or Section 206AB rate

requiredDocumentChecklist: Compliance Check for Section 206AB & 206CCA verification report from Income Tax e-filing portal
Acknowledgment of Income Tax Return (ITR-V) for preceding assessment year
Vendor PAN Card / TRACES status verification
